alignment: Corrected: each real and simulated episode is aligned to its own earliest client sent_ns; left-held 1.5 s samples are compared over the common observed horizon.

checks.request_count_identity: request/terminal counts and existing execution audits
checks.action_mask: 13-action mask length and executed action legal on every decision; not an identical-raw-input feature comparison
checks.outstanding_waiting_kv: absolute/relative area and per-instance MAE on common time grid
checks.reward: reconstruct V2 reward from real independent decisions and check timing/terminal identities; compare D,Q,H,B_star curves
checks.migration: compare successful counts and distinct request coverage; copy duration is not service pause

unavailable_checks: feature-order/unit numeric tolerance on identical raw snapshots
queue/KV slope and state age/receipt delay curve equivalence
